name: ApexBrake™ Pro-Series Ceramic Brake Rotor & Caliper Kit
description: Engineered for maximum stopping power and zero fade, the ApexBrake™ Pro-Series Ceramic Brake Rotor & Caliper Kit delivers track-calibrated deceleration and extended lifespan. Precision-slotted and drilled to rapidly dissipate heat and gas buildup, paired with OE-matched ceramic friction pads that reduce brake dust by 90% and eliminate squeal. Direct bolt-on replacement calibrated to factory specifications.

name: Blind Spot Car Mirror Set
description: Never miss a thing with these high-quality, wide-angle blind-spot mirrors. Perfect for cars, trucks, and SUVs. Easy peel-and-stick installation. Shatterproof design with durable ABS frame. Eliminates dangerous blind spots and enhances safety while driving, parking, and reversing.

name: Anti-Slip Dashboard Mat
description: This flexible and highly adhesive anti-slip dashboard mat keeps your essentials such as phones, keys, and sunglasses securely in place while driving. Crafted from premium silicone, it grips firmly without damaging your dashboard or leaving residue. It's easy to clean, reusable, and a perfect accessory for those who want to stay organized on the road.
